rationale: Chose B: the letters the two available prints show (Lazarus 1885 lacks the page), changing அழிவின்றி to அழிவின்று. Printed joined in Pope 1886 and Navalar (page crops in this entry's evidence); Navalar's commentary glosses அழிவு இன்று; Tamil Wikisource's Parimelazhagar text (L3) has the same join. Pope 1886 and Navalar both print the verse joined: அழிவின் றறைபோகா. In Tamil sandhi a final று drops its u before a vowel (இன்று + அறை → இன்றறை), while a final றி keeps its i and takes a ய glide (இன்றி + அறை → இன்றியறை). So the printed join fits இன்று. Navalar's commentary, which writes the words apart, glosses the phrase as “அழிவு இன்று”.
